item.title: Photo post
Avi Chawla 7 MoE routing strategies in production, clearly explained: (bookmark
item.description:
Avi Chawla
7 MoE routing strategies in production, clearly explained:

(bookmark this)

Sending every token to its highest-scoring experts can make an MoE model slower.

The problem is that many tokens can prefer the same experts. Those experts become overloaded while others remain underused.

With fixed capacity, some token assignments may be dropped. Across GPUs, uneven workloads and communication overhead can reduce the compute savings.

MoE routing has to select useful experts while distributing work efficiently.

The seven strategies in this visual handle that tradeoff differently.

> Token-choice routing

Each token selects its top-k experts using router scores. The expert count per token stays fixed, but expert loads can vary. Load-balancing mechanisms help prevent traffic from concentrating on a few experts.

> Expert-choice routing

Each expert selects its highest-scoring tokens within a fixed capacity. Expert workloads stay balanced, while individual tokens can receive different amounts of expert computation.

> Dynamic routing

The number of selected experts varies across tokens. Confidence-based variants allocate more experts when routing scores are less decisive, although router confidence doesn't directly measure token difficulty.

> Balanced assignment

A global matching procedure assigns tokens under expert load constraints. Some tokens may miss their highest-scoring expert to achieve a more balanced allocation. Computing that assignment adds overhead.

> Hash-based routing

A deterministic hash maps tokens to experts without a learned gate. This removes router learning, but expert selection has less flexibility to adapt to context.

> Soft MoE routing

Experts process weighted mixtures of token representations through slots. Each slot can combine information from multiple tokens, changing what an expert processes.

> Group-limited routing

The router restricts eligible expert groups before selecting experts. When groups reflect hardware placement, this can reduce communication across devices or nodes.

These choices affect how serving engines batch expert computation and distribute work across GPUs.

Evenly distributing tokens doesn't guarantee low latency. Expert batches may still be small, and moving tokens between devices takes time.

To dive deeper into MoE engineering, I covered everything in an article recently, including expert parallelism, grouped GEMM, topology-aware placement, memory requirements, and inference optimizations.

It follows what happens after the router selects experts and explains the tradeoffs that determine latency and throughput.

Read it below.

https://t.co/gaKOPeO2Db - Avi Chawla
tweet

item.title: Naval RT @mtracey : There's just no serious doubt that the "rape" prosecution of
item.description:
Naval
RT @mtracey: There's just no serious doubt that the "rape" prosecution of Russell Brand, for which he has now been convicted and jailed, was first precipitated by his very public turn toward vaguely right-wing (and admittedly often wacky) political and religious commentary.

In 2022, the Times (UK) published a big feature lambasting him for his purported transformation into some sort of dodgy right-wing "conspiracy guru."

Then in 2023 comes the big expose about Brand's allegedly sordid history of "sexual assault" and "abuse." The Times claimed they first started hearing of such allegations in 2019, but apparently had little urgency to follow up for several years.

Then all of the sudden, in "autumn 2022, Channel 4’s Dispatches formally began collaborating with The Sunday Times to investigate Brand."

Another notable event that occurred in "autumn 2022": Russell Brand was announced as a featured broadcaster on the right-wing (ish) video platform Rumble, alongside the likes of Donald Trump Jr. and Dan Bongino.

Soon enough, boom — here comes the newly frenzied "investigative" activity by the joint Times/Channel 4 task force — eventually yielding the big splashy 2023 "documentary" (more like "slopumentary”) which today they are bragging "led to" Brand's conviction in London for various sexual assault and rape offenses.

(He was also acquitted on multiple counts, in a very curious mixed verdict. NONE of the allegations aired in that 2023 propagandocumentary were ultimately charged at trial.)

Really makes U think...
tweet

item.description:
lidang 立党 （劝人卖房/学CS/买SP500/纳100/OpenAI/Anthrop第一人）
我是尚雯婕的毒唯，当年我是亲自帮尚雯婕投过票的，了解我的都知道，尚雯婕是唯一一个我买过签名专辑的歌手。

我觉得尚雯婕才需要被理解，毕竟能考上复旦本科的人，在人均中专的娱乐圈里，很少有能看上对眼的朋友，被许飞这种大傻逼现场对质简直尴尬死了。

我一直觉得，尚雯婕在音乐圈都是同事和熟人 ，没几个真正的朋友，朋友也都是音乐圈外的人，比如朱丹之类的。

尚雯婕是娱乐圈真正的独狼，这么多年来从来都没有人真正能懂她。
tweet
